settings.title: Sturdy worktop
settings.text: Beveled, rounded worktop coated with natural oil wax masterfully balances utility with natural design.

settings.title: Quick adjustment
settings.text: The smart height adjustment system allows you to save presets for sitting and standing and automatically change your position at the push of a button.

settings.title: Silent mechanism
settings.text: Twin-engine drive makes the motion of raising and lowering the tabletop a fast and silent affair. The maximum noise level is 45 dB.

settings.title: High-level ergonomics
settings.text: Allowing you to easily adjust its height, the Standing Desk revolutionizes your workspace and transforms it into an ergonomic haven for productivity, motivation, and wellbeing. Its sturdy construction, together with the smart height adjustment system allow you to precisely regulate your desk and smoothly change your position from sitting to standing – elevating your workspace comfort.

settings.title:
Your favourite position
in one tap
settings.text: The Atlas Lite comes with an adjustable height range of 27.5 ’’ 46 ’’. Move to you or your partner’s favorite position at ease with our programmable memory positions in one tap.
settings.right_text: From sitting to standing in 6 seconds

settings.title:
Stable yet quiet
precise to the millimeter
settings.text: Tired of wobbly desks that threatens your coffee and adjustments that don’t match your optimal height? Our Dual Motor are engineered for rock solid stability so you can work at ease and focused, even at the heights point. Our industrial-grade steel frame supports up to 265lb.

settings.title: Heavy duty material unparalled stability
settings.text: The Atlas Lite comes with a T-leg frame for unparralled stability even at the highest adjustment point. The legs are the heart of a standing desk and ours are engineered and primed to last the test of time.

settings.title: Lifts more. Lasts longer.
settings.text: Two motors, double efficiency. With a market leading lifting capacity, it's designed to operate smoothly under significant load, reducing noise and stress on the motors for a longer functional life.

settings.title: Cable management ready
settings.text: Keep your workspace neat and organized for a distraction-free environment.

settings.title: Build with confidence
settings.text_1: Our team of reliability experts put the rear hinged cover through 10,000 open and cycles to ensure that the hinge retains its resistance and smooth operation.
settings.text_2: Up and down. For 20,000 cycles. Dual electric motors engineered to keep up with you, even if you never stay still.
settings.text_3: A distributed load of 118kg was placed on the desk to ensure that the standing desk is able to withstand even the most complex multi-monitor setups.

settings.title: Which Desk is right for you ?
settings.text: You're probably wondering about your choices. So, we prepared this "fancy" table for you!

settings.heading: 1. Who is the Atlas Lite standing desk designed for?
settings.content: As an electric standing desk, the Atlas Lite is ideal for home offices and gaming setups, offering a practical, organized, and comfortable workspace for work or play.

settings.heading: 2. Are Atlas Lite standing desks actually good for your health?
settings.content: Yes. Using an electric height-adjustable standing desk like the Atlas Lite promotes better posture, reduces prolonged sitting, and can support overall well-being during long work hours.

settings.heading: 3. How do I adjust the Atlas desk height?
settings.content: The Atlas is an electric standing desk with dual motors, letting you raise or lower it smoothly and quietly at the push of a button.

settings.heading: 4. Does the Atlas desk have memory positions?
settings.content: Yes, the Atlas desk’s programmable memory positions make height adjustments fast and effortless, perfect for switching between work and gaming setups.

settings.heading: 5. Can I use the Atlas Lite desk for work as well as gaming?
settings.content: Yes. The Atlas Lite standing desk is versatile enough for both work and gaming. Its smooth dual-motor height adjustment, memory positions, and cable management make it perfect for a productive home office setup as well as a comfortable gaming station.

settings.heading: 6. What is the warranty on the Atlas Lite desk?
settings.content: Every Atlas Lite includes a 3-year warranty, just like all Blacklyte standing desks. For added protection, you can join our Extended Warranty Program to extend coverage by 2 more years and receive a $10 cashback.
